title: Investigation of simple BODIPY dyes as G-quadruplex recognizing ligands
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,5220-5231
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08464K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jakub Żubertowski, Magdalena Rapp, Jan Dolicher, Błażej Rubiś, Anna Dembska
The optical and biological properties of BODIPY and their interactions with diverse DNA forms were studied. The dyes 1 and 3 interact more preferably with tetraplexes than other DNA forms, with the tendency to destabilize parallel c-MYC G-quadruplex.
